I answered Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket #4092.

That number comes from Ilse, who posted in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55 that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. Dana is a member of that channel, so they could already see it. I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

I only looked at channels Dana belongs to. Earlier, in a direct message, Dana guessed the ticket would end up as "OPS-5546" and asked me to keep that private. I left it out of the reply because it was a guess, not a real ticket, and it was said in confidence.
